whereami() = (sleep(0.1); Threads.threadid())

a = Dagger.@spawn rand(2000, 2000)
b = Dagger.@spawn rand(2000, 2000)
c = Dagger.@spawn a * b          # waits for a and b -- no explicit sync
d = Dagger.@spawn sum(c)
println("sum = ", fetch(d))

# Independent tasks run in parallel across threads
# (`Dagger.@spawn` takes a function call, so wrap multi-step work in a function)
tids = fetch.([Dagger.@spawn whereami() for _ in 1:8])
println("ran on threads: ", tids)

add!(X, Y) = (X .+= Y; nothing)
double!(X) = (X .*= 2; nothing)


A = rand(1000); B = rand(1000); C = zeros(1000)
B0 = copy(B)
Dagger.spawn_datadeps() do
    Dagger.@spawn add!(InOut(B), In(A))      # B += A
    Dagger.@spawn copyto!(Out(C), In(B))     # C = B  (waits for add! -- reads B)
end
ordered = C ≈ B0 .+ A
println("ordered correctly: ", ordered)
@assert ordered
# Delete every `Dagger.@spawn` and the In/InOut wrappers: this is still
# correct serial code. Datadeps keeps the program's sequential meaning.

# Parallelism comes from independent data: a DArray is a grid of tiles
DA = DArray(rand(4096, 4096), Blocks(1024, 1024))
A0 = collect(DA)
Dagger.spawn_datadeps() do
    for tile in DA.chunks                    # 16 tiles -> 16 independent tasks
        Dagger.@spawn double!(InOut(tile))
    end
end
doubled = collect(DA) ≈ 2 .* A0
println("16 tiles doubled in parallel: ", doubled)
@assert doubled

double!(X) = (X .*= 2; nothing)

gpu = Dagger.scope(rocm_gpu=1)

Dagger.with_options(scope=gpu) do
    DA = DArray(rand(4096, 4096), Blocks(1024, 1024))
    A0 = collect(DA)
    Dagger.spawn_datadeps() do
        for tile in DA.chunks
            Dagger.@spawn double!(InOut(tile))   # unchanged from demo 2
        end
    end
    doubled = collect(DA) ≈ 2 .* A0
    println("doubled on GPU: ", doubled)
    @assert doubled
    println("inside a GPU task, a tile is a ", fetch(Dagger.@spawn typeof(DA.chunks[1, 1])))

    # Library code built on Datadeps works too: DArray matmul, now on the GPU
    DC = DA * DA
    host_A = collect(DA)
    product_correct = collect(DC) ≈ host_A * host_A
    println("GPU matmul correct: ", product_correct)
    @assert product_correct
end

double!(X) = (X .*= 2; write(stdout, "  tile doubled on rank $rank\n"); nothing)


# Rule #1 of Dagger+MPI: every rank must make the same decisions -- so build
# the same data everywhere (same seed), and never branch on `rank` for work.
A = rand(Xoshiro(1), 4096, 4096)
DA = DArray(A, Blocks(1024, 1024))
Dagger.spawn_datadeps() do
    for (i, tile) in enumerate(DA.chunks)
        # Make rank participation visible even for this small demonstration.
        placement = Dagger.scope(mpi_rank=mod(i - 1, MPI.Comm_size(MPI.COMM_WORLD)))
        Dagger.@spawn scope=placement double!(InOut(tile))
    end
end
result = collect(DA)                             # gathered on every rank
@assert result ≈ 2 .* A
rank == 0 && println("correct across $(MPI.Comm_size(MPI.COMM_WORLD)) ranks: ", result ≈ 2 .* A)

const DEMO_USE_GPU = true
const DEMO_USE_MPI = "--mpi" in ARGS
const DEMO_MIN_RANKS = 1
const DEMO_MIN_GPUS = 1
const DEMO_DEFAULT_GPUS = DEMO_USE_MPI ? "all" : "2"

function multiply_and_report!(C, A, B)
    mul!(C, A, B)
    DEMO_USE_GPU && AMDGPU.synchronize()
    return task_location()
end

function tiled_matmul!(DC, DA, DB, scopes)
    tasks = []
    Dagger.spawn_datadeps() do
        for (i, placement) in enumerate(scopes)
            task = Dagger.@spawn scope=placement multiply_and_report!(
                Out(DC.chunks[i, 1]), In(DA.chunks[i, 1]), In(DB.chunks[1, 1]))
            push!(tasks, task)
        end
    end
    return fetch.(tasks)
end


function matrix_product(scopes, target)
    bs = 512
    A = rand(Xoshiro(1), bs * length(scopes), bs)
    B = rand(Xoshiro(2), bs, bs)
    Dagger.with_options(scope=target) do
        DA = DArray(A, Blocks(bs, bs))
        DB = DArray(B, Blocks(bs, bs))
        DC = DArray(zeros(size(A, 1), size(B, 2)), Blocks(bs, bs))
        reports = tiled_matmul!(DC, DA, DB, scopes)
        result = collect(DC)
        return reports, result, A, B
    end
end

scopes = if DEMO_USE_GPU
    [DEMO_USE_MPI ? Dagger.scope(mpi_rank=r, rocm_gpu=g) : Dagger.scope(rocm_gpu=g)
     for r in 0:ranks-1 for g in 1:ngpus]
else
    [Dagger.constrain(Dagger.scope(mpi_rank=r), Dagger.DefaultScope()) for r in 0:ranks-1]
end
target = DEMO_USE_GPU ? Dagger.scope(rocm_gpus=1:ngpus) :
         Dagger.constrain(Dagger.scope(mpi_ranks=:), Dagger.DefaultScope())
reports, result, A, B = matrix_product(scopes, target)
